title: fix: correct Realtime cached image billing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Bills cached image input at $0.50/M for `gpt-realtime-2` and `gpt-realtime-2.1` while keeping cached text/audio at $0.40/M.
- Applies the confirmed Azure `priceMultiplier: 0.75` to both models.
- Keeps model IDs, Sweden Central deployments, access, modalities, and no-fallback routing unchanged.

## Confirmed contract

| Model | Provider | Paid only | Multiplier | Route |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `gpt-realtime-2.1` | Azure | No | 0.75 | Sweden Central / `gpt-realtime-2-1` |
| `gpt-realtime-2` | Azure | No | 0.75 | Sweden Central / `gpt-realtime-2` |

Sources: [GPT Realtime 2.1 pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime-2.1), [GPT Realtime 2 pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime-2), [Azure Retail Prices API](https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices).

## Verification

- Gen focused billing/observability suite: 90 passed.
- Gen full suite: 713 passed, 6 skipped.
- Enter aliases/pricing/snapshot suite: 298 passed.
- Gen and Enter typechecks pass.
- Route-level Realtime tests verify cached text/audio/image usage, wallet deduction, adjustment metadata, and Tinybird totals for both models.

Full Enter also ran; unrelated Stripe tests require a missing local `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`. The focused pricing suite is green.

gist.headline: Cached pixels count properly
gist.blurb: The realtime hive got its calculator recalibrated. Cached image input for GPT Realtime 2 and 2.1 now lands in the right billing bucket, while text and audio keep their own tidy rate.
gist.summary: Corrected Azure billing for cached image input on `gpt-realtime-2` and `gpt-realtime-2.1` to $0.50/M, retained cached text/audio at $0.40/M, and applied the confirmed `priceMultiplier: 0.75` to both Sweden Central routes.
gist.impact: Realtime users now receive accurate wallet deductions and usage totals for cached image, text, and audio input on both GPT Realtime models, with routing and model access unchanged.
